aside.registeredBody: Sign in and your details fill in for you.

benefits.track: Your keys are kept in your account, encrypted
benefits.addresses: Reveal and copy them when you’re ready to play
benefits.saved: Every order comes with a PDF invoice

meta.title: Sign in
meta.description: Sign in to Keyterminus to see your keys, orders and saved keys.

login.title: Sign in
login.checkoutHint: Sign in to check out. Nothing in your cart changes.
login.failed: We couldn’t sign you in. Try again.

meta.title: Create an account
meta.description: Open a Keyterminus account to buy game keys, gift cards and subscriptions and keep them in one place.

register.title: Create an account
register.lead: Four short steps. Your details go on your invoice and confirm you’re old enough to buy.
register.checkFields: Check {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}
register.restricted: We don’t open accounts or accept orders in {countries}.
register.terms: I have read and agree to the <link>Terms and Conditions</link>
register.privacy: How we handle your details is set out in the <link>Privacy policy</link>.
register.failed: We couldn’t create your account. Try again.
register.marketing: Send me emails about price cuts and new arrivals. You can unsubscribe whenever you like.

meta.title: Reset your password
meta.description: Get a link to choose a new Keyterminus password.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your account’s email address and we’ll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If {email} has an account, the link is on its way. It works for {minutes} minutes.
forgot.sentHint: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder.
forgot.failed: We couldn’t send the link. Try again.

meta.title: Choose a new password
meta.description: Choose a new password for your Keyterminus account.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.invalidBody: Ask for a new link and use it within the time given in the email.
reset.doneBody: Your new password is set. Use it next time you sign in.
reset.failed: We couldn’t change your password. Try again.
